Now I can see it, and it's just right. When I typed "recipes" in lowercase and hit Create & add, it didn't make a new lowercase tag — it picked out my existing "Recipes" and told me plainly "Used your existing 'Recipes' label," so I know what it did and why. After saving, the card shows exactly Work and Recipes — two labels, no sneaky third lowercase duplicate hiding in there.

That's the behavior I wanted, and it keeps my labels from quietly multiplying into near-identical copies. The reuse boundary is right too. This is settled.
